cycle.assumption: Deterministic A -> B -> A introduces no new observation or likelihood

diamond.assumption: Both deterministic branches equal the very same source event

false_hypothesis.assumption: Deterministic hypothesis H0 predicts no success; observe success without noise; alternative predicts success

unequal.assumption: Product only under explicit independent-event model

native_stv_interpretation: Unspecified; no Beta or full posterior interpretation assumed

assumptions: Once: one Bernoulli likelihood; duplicate likelihood is an intentionally different two-event model
Shared coupled datum: uniform latent bits conditioned on equality
Factorized vector datum: independent theta priors and product of two local-success likelihoods
Sharing a dataset label alone imposes none of these joint laws

parameter_reuse.assumption: Two Bernoulli trials conditionally independent given shared theta; redrawing and same-event cases are distinct models

scope: Illustrative finite probability models, not native PLN semantics or measured chess probabilities
